arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Rienzi argued sidewalks are special. He cited First Amendment protections for speech.
Ms. Miller said the sides that brought the case can protest. She noted they use public spaces.
Mr. Gershengorn called the law neutral. He said it moves speech, not bans it.
Justice Ginsburg noted past disturbances. She said the state cannot predict behavior.
